badge.localHint: This identity is a local profile stored only in this browser. The server runs in local mode and does not verify it.

signIn.ssoLede: Single sign-on through {{provider}}. Your name, role and institution come from your university identity provider and are verified by the AcuDx server.
signIn.ssoHint: OpenID Connect with PKCE. No password is entered in AcuDx; the access token stays in memory only.
signIn.ssoUnavailable: The identity provider did not publish an authorization endpoint. Ask your administrator to probe the identity provider in the admin console.
signIn.ssoNotConfigured: This deployment requires institution sign-in, but no identity provider is configured yet. Ask your administrator to add one under Admin, Providers, kind identity.
signIn.gatewayDown: The AcuDx gateway could not be reached, so only the local profile is available right now.
signIn.localNote: Local profiles are for air-gapped demos. Dean, faculty and admin surfaces opened from a local profile are not verified and the server marks every response X-Auth-Mode: local.

callback.title: Finishing sign-in
callback.lede: Exchanging the authorization code and loading your verified profile.
callback.failedLede: Nothing was stored. You can try again from the sign-in screen.

profile.managedByIdp: Your name, role and institution are managed by your identity provider and cannot be edited here.
profile.roleVerifiedHint: Verified from your institution token. Ask an administrator to change it.
